description_en: Grants Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user
description_zh: 调用CreateNetworkInterfacePermission为阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）或者个人用户授权弹性网卡权限
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-network-interface-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --account-id 1234567890 --network-interface-id eni-bp14v2sdd3v8htln0000 --permission InstanceAttach --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNetworkInterfacePermission

parameters.help_en: The region of the network interface controller (NIC) permission. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡权限的地域。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) account or individual user account
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）账号ID或者个人用户ID
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
The network interface controller (NIC) permission action. Only InstanceAttach is supported.

InstanceAttach: allows the authorized user to attach your NIC to their ECS instance. The ECS instance must be in the same zone as the NIC
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡权限动作。当前仅支持InstanceAttach。

InstanceAttach：允许授权的用户将您的弹性网卡挂载到对方的ECS实例上。ECS实例必须和弹性网卡在同一个可用区中
parameters.name: permission

NetworkInterfacePermission.description_en: The information about the network interface controller (NIC) permissions
NetworkInterfacePermission.description_zh: 弹性网卡权限列表组成的信息集合

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) account
AccountId.description_zh: 阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）账号ID

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC)

NetworkInterfacePermissionId.description_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC) permission

PermissionState.description_en:
The status of the network interface controller (NIC) permission. Valid values:

Pending: Authorization in progress.
Granted: Authorization granted.
Revoking: Authorization being revoked.
Revoked: Authorization revoked
PermissionState.description_zh:
弹性网卡权限状态。可能值：

Pending：授权中。
Granted：已授权。
Revoking：撤销授权中。
Revoked：已撤销授权
